validation.url: Must be a valid http(s) URL
validation.phone: Digits only, with country code (8 to 15)
validation.variableName: Letters, numbers and _ (not starting with a number)

accounts.pageHelp: Each account is a Meta app with its WhatsApp Business Account. Tokens are stored encrypted and never shown in full again.
accounts.createHelp: Get these values from Meta for Developers: your app → WhatsApp → API Setup (token and WABA ID) and App settings → Basic (App ID and App Secret).
accounts.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? Its numbers and conversations are deleted too.

hints.name: To recognize it in the dashboard
hints.wabaId: API Setup → WhatsApp Business Account ID
hints.accessToken: Use a permanent system user token
hints.appSecret: Used to verify each webhook signature
hints.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current value

validate.help: We test the token against the WhatsApp Business Account.

webhook.step1: In Meta for Developers, open your app → WhatsApp → Configuration.
webhook.step2: Under Webhook, click Edit and paste the callback URL and the verify token.
webhook.step3: Save and subscribe to the "{{fields}}" field.

numbers.help: We fetch the account's numbers. Then assign a bot to each one on the Numbers screen.

subscribe.help: Subscribes the app to the WhatsApp Business Account to receive messages. Needed once per account.

test.help: Send a message to confirm sending works. Outside the 24 h window Meta rejects it: message the number from your phone first.
test.defaultText: Hi! This is a test message from Darmoz.

numbers.pageHelp: Numbers are fetched from the account (Accounts → Connect → Sync). Assign each one the bot that answers it.
numbers.deleteMessage: Remove {{name}}? Its conversations are deleted. You can bring it back by syncing the account.

integrations.pageHelp: How bots call their application's API: base URL and a fixed header (API key) added to every HTTP node call.
integrations.help: One integration per darmoz-auth application. HTTP nodes can only use paths relative to this URL.
integrations.baseUrlHint: Inside the server, the container name (e.g. http://vivos-admin-be:8080/vivos-api)
integrations.deleteMessage: Delete the "{{name}}" integration? Its bots' HTTP nodes will take the error branch.
integrations.testHelp: Makes a real call to {{baseUrl}} with the configured header.

bots.pageHelp: Each bot belongs to an application and answers on its assigned numbers, following its flows.
bots.createHelp: Then you can create its flows and set up messages and hours.
bots.name: Name
bots.entryFlowHint: Where every conversation starts. Must be published.
bots.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}" and all its flows? Its numbers are left without a bot.
bots.fallbackMessage: Message when there is no flow
bots.fallbackMessageHint: Sent while the bot has no published entry flow
bots.sessionTimeoutHint: With no messages from the contact for this long, the conversation starts over
bots.staticVariablesHint: Fixed values flows use as {{example}}, e.g. the store id for HTTP calls.

flows.help: A flow is a graph of steps. The bot runs the latest published version; saving does not change what contacts see until you publish.
flows.name: Name

editor.title: Flow editor
editor.selectNode: Pick a step on the canvas to edit it. Connect the outputs (on the right of each step) to the next step's input.
editor.variablesHint: Variables: {{contactName}}, {{contactPhone}}, {{botVariable}} and the ones the flow saves, like {{savedVariable}}
editor.conditionHelp: The first matching rule picks the output; if none, it goes through "else".
editor.httpHelp: Calls the bot's application API with its API key. Adds the X-Whatsapp-From header with the contact's number.

descriptions.message: Sends a text, an image or a document and continues.
descriptions.buttons: Up to 3 buttons. Waits for the answer; each button is an output.
descriptions.list: Drop-down menu with up to 10 options. Waits for the answer.
descriptions.question: Asks, validates the answer and saves it in a variable.
descriptions.condition: Picks the path based on a variable's value.
descriptions.http: Calls an application endpoint and saves the response.
descriptions.set_variable: Saves a value in a variable.
descriptions.goto_flow: Continues at the start of another flow of the bot.
descriptions.handoff: Sends the text and stops answering: a person takes over.
descriptions.end: Sends the text and closes the conversation.

fields.question: Question
fields.buttonText: Text of the button that opens the list
fields.caption: Caption
fields.saveAsHint: Then use it as {{example}} in other steps
fields.httpSaveAsHint: The whole response goes in this variable (e.g. api → {{example}})
fields.errorMessageHint: Sent before asking again (if the "invalid answer" output is not connected)
